label: Bodleian Library MS. Pers. c. 37

metadata.value: Full catalogue record in Fihrist: Union Catalogue of Manuscripts from the Islamicate World

metadata.label: Author
metadata.value: Akhavaynī, Rabīʻ ibn Aḥmad, active 10th century

metadata.label: Date Statement
metadata.value: End of Rabīʻ I 478 AH; July 1085 CE

metadata.label: Description
metadata.value: A copy of Abū Bakr (Abū Ḥakīm) Rabīʻ ibn Aḥmad al-Akhavayn al-Bukhārī's early medical encyclopaedia in Persian, Hidayat al-mutaʻallimīn fī al-ṭibb. Akhavayn or Akhavaynī was a pupil of Muḥammad ibn Zakarīyyā al-Rāzī and wrote this work in 183 chapters. This copy, dated 478/1085, is the oldest dated Persian manuscript in the Bodleian Libraries and there is only one other copy extant - Istanbul Fatih, 3646.

metadata.label: Contents
metadata.value: Abū Bakr (Abū Ḥakīm) Rabīʻ ibn Aḥmad al-Akhavayn al-Bukhārī', هداية المتعلّمين في الطب (pp. 1–662).
